text: Episode nine. Recurring events. A weekly session, set up once — first as the organizer writing the rule, then as someone who just wants to know when the next one is.
Describe the night once, as a template. A name, a start and end time, and where it happens. Tickets or a simple R S V P. Every week from here on is built from this one blueprint.
Then the rule. Weekly, on Thursdays, with no end date. Auto-publish means each new date goes live the moment it's made, eight weeks ahead — and Revel keeps the calendar topped up by itself.

One click, and there are the coming Thursdays. Every one is a real event, with its own page, its own R S V P list, and its own capacity. Change the template and the change carries forward. Cancel one week without touching the rest.
For your people, the series has a page of its own, with every date on it. Follow it, and each new date lands in their notifications as it's added. No need to keep checking back.
Set it up once, and it runs every week. Revel is free and open source. Find it at lets revel dot io.
